name: Bridge Connecting Winter and Spring
description: A stone bridge spans a calm river where one side is snowy winter and the other is blossoming spring, blending at the center.
prompt: A single symbolic landscape of a stone bridge over a calm river. Left bank is winter with snow and bare trees, right bank is spring with blossoms and gentle rain. The bridge center blends both seasons, soft light, emotional, detailed, no text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: Some crossings are between seasons, not places.
